paite: Huchiin Jobin a gentehna thu apan nawna, huchiin a chi a:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: Pathian a hing bangin, aman ka dikna a la manga; huan Thil bangkim hihtheiin, aman ka kha a hih buai a;
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter.

paite: Ka hinna ka sunga a om laiteng, huan Pathian hu ka nakvanga a om laiteng?
english: (For the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

paite: Ka mukten thutaklou a gen kei ding, ka leiin leng khemna thu a gen kei ding.
english: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

paite: Siam kon tansak mahmah kei ding hi: ka sihma tan ka takna kei akipanin ka koih mang kei ding hi.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

paite: Ka diktatna ka len chintena, ka khah kei ding hi: ka damlai teng ka lungtangin kei honkou kei ding.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

paite: Ka melma gilou bang hi henla, huan kei dou dia thou mi diktatlou bang hihen.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

paite: Punna muta mahleh, Pathian limsakloumi lametna, Pathian in a kha a lak mang ngalin, bang ahia?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

paite: A tunga buaina a tunin, a kikou Pathian in a za diam?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

paite: Thil bangkim hihthei ah nuam asa in, chiklaipeuhin Pathian sap nuam asa diam?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

paite: Pathian khut tungtangah nang ka honsinsak ding; Thil bangkim hihthei kianga om ken ka im kei ding hi.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

paite: Ngai un, noute tengteng in huai na muta ua; ahihngalleh, bangdia bangmahlou honghi vek na hi ua?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

paite: Hiai Pathian laka mi gilou tantuan leh, nuaisiahhat mite goutan, Thil bangkim hihthei akipana a muh uh ahi.
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

paite: A tate a pun uleh, nuamsau ading ahi; huan a suan tanghouin a tai kei ding hi.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

paite: A nunga omlaite hi lengin a vuidia, huan a meithaite un kahna a bawl kei ding uh.
english: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.

paite: Dangka leivui bangin vum touin, puansilh tungman bangin bawl mahleh;
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

paite: A bawl thei, himahleh mi dikten a silh ding, huan mi hoihten dangka pen a hawm ding hi.
english: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

paite: Inn a lam tuh maimom len bang ahia, vengmiin a bawl aidakbuk bang ahi.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

paite: Hausa inn a luma, himahleh khopin a om kei ding; a mit a haka, huan a om kei.
english: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

paite: Tuite bangin launaten amah a pha a; janin huihpiin amah a gu mang hi.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

paite: Suahlam huihin amah a po manga, huan a pai mang hi; huchiin a mun akipanin amah a mut mang hi
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

paite: Pathianin lah amah nakpiin a lawn dia, a dawm kei ding: a khut akipan taimang a ut ding.Miten amah a khut uh a bet khum ding ua, huan a mun akipanin amah a nuihsan khe ding uhi.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

paite: Miten amah a khut uh a bet khum ding ua, huan a mun akipanin amah a nuihsan khe ding uhi.
english: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
